## Summary

**No resend was needed — and resending would have caused a duplicate.**

**What I found:**
- `portal_status` for INV04774: **posted 1 time(s)** in Corrandale's SAP.
- `/archive/INV04774.edi` exists and is **byte-identical** to my local outbox copy (same interchange control reference `569844`, same 12 line items, same totals) — so yesterday's upload was picked up by the poller and translated successfully.
- `/inbound` is empty (no stuck `.part` or unprocessed `.edi` file), `/error` is empty (no `.err` note, so no hourly AP alerts are firing), and there are no leftover temp files.

**Action taken on the SFTP server: none — deliberately.** The partner guide states SAP posts every interchange it receives and does *not* check for duplicate invoice numbers. Since the invoice is already posted exactly once, uploading the file again would have posted it a second time. The server is already in the state the guide requires: nothing in `/inbound`, nothing in `/error`, and the processed file correctly retained in `/archive`.

**What to tell Corrandale's accounts payable team:**

> Invoice INV04774 was received and processed successfully — it is in your SAP system, posted exactly once. The interchange (control reference 569844, dated 2026-11-02, 12 line items, net EUR 44,296.48 + VAT 7,382.74 = EUR 51,679.22) was delivered yesterday and has been archived on your SFTP server as `/archive/INV04774.edi`; there is no error note against it. We have not resent it, because your SAP system does not de-duplicate invoice numbers and a resend would create a second posting. Please re-check your search — it may be sitting under a different document/entry date or still in an approval/blocked status rather than missing. If you still can't see it, send us the document number you're searching on and we'll help trace it.

One thing worth flagging internally: the "we can't find it" query was a lookup/visibility issue on their side, not a delivery failure — worth checking whether their AP team is searching on the wrong reference before we treat similar queries as resend requests.
